notes.title: v1.4 is live!
notes.notes:
There was a really good, sensible suggestion in a recent review:

[i]"The only minor point is I think the artifacts in inventory should be graphically represented as icons, probably somewhere on top of screen similar to slay the spire. Even though you don't often carry many, I often forget which ones I have and for that you need to select your inventory and then click in the dropdown menu of a specific artifact, because of course you forget what they do at the beginning."[/i]

Today, I'm happy to announce that the version 1.4 of Words of Yendor has been released.

The equipables are now listed on the Toolbelt, at the left side of the screen. Just hover the icons with your mouse to read the descriptions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/ed6e877c022c836563504478210a5709e353e403.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix for 2 locked achievements
notes.notes:
This quick update fixes a bug that prevented two achievements ("Legacy Retained" and "Mob Justice") from being awarded when they should have been.

This explains why only my personal Steam account had these unlocked. I'm not bragging, and I'm definitely not proud of it -- mistakes happen, but I'm committed to fixing everything. Eventually. :)

Cheers,
Sandor

notes.title: Game Update: v1.3 out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/7cb0394439378d0b21456672483ae2fbf2f8aff6.png[/img]

Among minor, user experience-related improvements, like [i]showing a reminder if you forget to use teleport-swaps in Showdowns[/i], the version 1.3 of Words of Yendor introduces a new variation to hangman puzzles, encountered at Suspicious Accidents.

Starting from the 4th settlements, instead of trying to guess just a single word, an almost randomly selected verse from a 19th century poem will have to be solved. But, be careful, in these puzzles a tier-1 letter (the most common letters in English words) can only be submitted as guess after making 2 successful guesses with a higher tier letter.

For example, in a 4th, 5th, or 6th settlement a Suspicious Accident might start like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/b34e2aaa60f45b53750e7b6edd87011e63a0e696.png[/img]
Notice while you can see the word distributions, none of the letters are revealed at the start and you only have 3 opportunities for a miss before your health suffers. The purple lock icons indicate that tier-1 letters are not available at the moment, but you'll also get a reminder as tooltips.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/2fcca60a4aed31e347a81779c09fe6646525993b.png[/img]
Here, after successfully submitting H and L, a single opportunity to submit a tier-1 letter was unlocked, and the choice of E has revealed some useful hints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/e5f2a21a58eb157f060e2e8c599a5440584b497c.png[/img]
Finally, the verse was successfully solved, and the poem's title and author were also shown.

Since there are more than 3200 verses in the game's database, you'll encounter some inspiring, poignant, or thought-provoking lines, and in every case, the solution will reveal the poem's title and author.

I hope you'll enjoy this variation in these puzzles.

Cheers,
Sandor

notes.title: Bug fixes and a global error handler
notes.notes:
This small update corrects a rare bug that has caused a crash when an opponent was defeated in the very first turn using a consumable like Focused Strike, even before composing a word.

Another bug has been squished that allowed the unlimited accumulation of Experience and Clues points by exiting and reloading the game just after a successful resolution of a Suspicious Accident.

[i]Behold, one more:[/i]

From now on, if the game crashes, a notification will appear on the Main Menu, letting the player decide if they wish to assist the correction of the problem by sending the archived game state file to me, the developer, as an email attachment. The notification will look like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/433dd4143ec7860c092ee3f1ddbdb25c68b144b2.png[/img]
Of course, sending bug reports is never obligatory, yet I believe this new error handling feature helps keeping Words of Yendor to remain a reliable source of entertainment and an enjoyable experience.

notes.title: Game Update: v1.1 out now!
notes.notes:
The v1.1 update implements game balance adjustments and generic improvements for the user experience.

[list][*]Showdowns are now (optionally) less cruel. As you know, in this puzzle, each letter swap costs some of your accumulated Experience and Clues points. Once any of these runs out, the price for each swap is the loss of 1 Health. Since this update, [i]while your Health is below the half of its maximum[/i], you'll also [i]receive a teleport-swap charge[/i] to give you an extra chance to complete these puzzles.
[*]Scouting: An icon reminds you of the risk (or the lack of it) of failure in Scouting puzzles. This is the same icon you see in the top left corner of the encounter cards.
[*]Assassins: They are still quite deadly, but their defense has been reduced.
[*]Screensaves (shortcut: F11) filenames now contain the length of the Word along with the adventure seed; the screensaves can be found in the data directory, accessible from the Main Menu's top left corner.
[*]Various bug fixes and adjustments for minor visual glitches.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/4279f8f429957ef6459356f7bb11ac82e6afaa1f.png[/img]

notes.title: Announcing beta v1.1: "Showdown Revamped" -- available now for all
notes.notes:
Some players have shared their love for Words of Yendor, but some found the Showdown puzzles too hard. Indeed, balancing a game is an art, as players sometimes seek a tough challenge, but sometimes they just want to relax.

I'm proudly announcing a solution: a new feature has been activated to make Showdowns more approachable. As you know, when a Showdown proves too tough and you run out of Experience and Clues points for swaps, the adventurer will have to pay 1 Health per swap instead. Thanks to the new feature, when your Health drops below half of its Maximum, you'll receive a teleport-swap charge as a compensation for each such Health loss. As a reminder, a teleport-swap allows you to swap any two letters on the board, so they don't have to be next to each other.

I'd appreciate your feedback on this game-altering patch before I publish the updated game for everyone.

To ensure this change aligns with your preferences, a beta branch have been created, so you can check out the revamped Showdown. You can now choose which version you wish to play on Steam: the original version or the beta version with the altered Showdown. You can switch between the versions at any time, but please note that saved games are version-specific.

To switch between versions, follow these steps:
[list][*] Open the Steam desktop application.
[*] Go to "Library."
[*] In the left sidebar, find "Words of Yendor" and right-click.
[*] Select "Properties."
[*] Choose "Betas" from the left sidebar.
[*] Select "beta - Testing the next version" from the "Beta Participation" dropdown.
[*] Steam will automatically download and switch to the v1.1 build.
[*] You can switch back to the main public version (v1.0) by selecting "None" in the "Beta Participation" dropdown.
[*] You can check the version number on the Credits screen.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/373d451b23e38f0ad3a44d2df3332934baf58c32.png[/img]

I believe this change significantly enhances the user experience without any drawbacks.

Your feedback is crucial; please share your thoughts.

Best regards,
Sandor, the designer/developer of Words of Yendor

notes.title: Fixing a rare bug, that crashed the game after solving a Showdown

The crash has only happened if your Toolbelt was completely empty (so you have used, sold or dropped all your consumables), [i]and[/i] a specific type of reward was offered in the Dark Chamber.

notes.title: Small, but meaningful update
notes.notes:
Thanks to player suggestions, this update introduces a small but meaningful change that improves the gameplay experience for everyone.

Each encounter card has an icon in the top left corner that indicates what happens if scouting that encounter fails. Either there is no negative consequence, or the encounter card becomes inaccessible at that location, or, it might happen that the encounter automatically activates, which can be dangerous.

Until now, these icons were only visible for encounters that have already been scouted. But with this update, these icons are always visible:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/691a4406683574db802d986b9d88f4e8525f80fd.png[/img]

So, it's no longer a gamble to decide if there is a serious risk to scouting, or the worst that can happen is that you don't get more Clues or maybe miss out on an extra encounter option. However, if you already have a revealed encounter that looks acceptable, and you are facing an unscouted encounter that is probably hard to scout and is indicated to be dangerous, you might just keep playing it safe.

notes.title: Showdowns are in the demo now!
notes.notes:
Until now, the demo did not include Showdowns, the special word puzzle that awaits you after defeating the Master Villain of the current settlement. Showdowns are where you'll uncover the next piece of the Grand Puzzle, the next Lesser Word of Yendor that brings you closer to solving the mystery of the adventure.

By popular demand, the demo has been extended, and now you can experience the excitement of Showdowns too. However, please note that in the demo the adventure will still conclude after completing the 2nd settlement.

Remember, Showdowns can range from very challenging to relatively easy, especially the first one when you haven't yet discovered any Lesser Words. But that's the essence of roguelike-style procedural generation, and therein lies the beauty: the thrill of the challenge and the immense satisfaction when you emerge victorious!

It has been mentioned before, but it is important to emphasize: each adventure in Words of Yendor is tailor-made to grant a personal reward, when you complete the full story -- and there are infinite amount of stories in the game.

Do, check out the updated demo, and make sure to have Words of Yendor on your wishlist, so you can get a notification once the full game becomes available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/091696af100c569c39a063c7cdce2768adbae699.png[/img]

notes.title: Word list extended, custom word editor made more accessible
notes.notes:
Before this update -- which includes both the demo and the full version -- Words of Yendor has recognized about 250 000 words. Some of these were only accepted from the player, since the puzzles and the opponents only use words appropriate for the steamgoth setting.

With today's update I have added about 100 000 additional words to the game's dictionary. But it can still happen that you want to use a word, that you [i]know[/i] to be valid, only having to see that the game doesn't recognize it. An outrage, I agree!

The truth is, Words of Yendor has always had an editor meant to be used by you, the player, to register words, exactly for this purpose. It was (and is) accessible from the Main Menu, by moving the mouse to the top-right corner of the screen.

Since today's update this semi-secret button has a visual reminder (along with its sibling that opens the game's data directory for you to access your screenshots, custom word list file, high scores list, settings and the saved game state -- this latter one only for scientific purposes, and definitely [i]not[/i] for making a copy of it, in case that the Assassin proves to be too strong), so hopefully more of you'll be able to extend the game's dictionary to your likings.

Though this feature is not a new one, thanks to your feedback I have been able to find a better way to announce its existence. If there's anything you think Words of Yendor could be improved by, do not hesitate to let its humble and grateful developer know, maybe here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2156830/discussions/
